definitions.explanation: A television series or show, typically with a continuing story

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}ドラマを{見|み}るのが{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I look forward to watching dramas every week.

examples.japanese: この{試合|しあい}はドラマのような{展開|てんかい}だった。
examples.english: This match had a dramatic development like a drama.

examples.japanese: {韓国|かんこく}ドラマにはまっている。
{人気|にんき}ドラマの{最終回|さいしゅうかい}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the finale of the popular drama.

notes:
ドラマ primarily refers to TV dramas/series in Japanese.

TYPES OF DRAMAS:
- {連続|れんぞく}ドラマ / {連|れん}ドラ: serial drama
- {月曜|げつよう}ドラマ: Monday drama (TV time slot)
- ラブコメディ / ラブコメ: romantic comedy
- {刑事|けいじ}ドラマ: detective drama
- {韓国|かんこく}ドラマ / {韓|かん}ドラ: Korean drama

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドラマを{見|み}る: to watch a drama
- ドラマにはまる: to get hooked on a drama
- ドラマに{出演|しゅつえん}する: to appear in a drama

VS {劇|げき}:
- ドラマ: usually TV dramas
- {劇|げき}: theater plays, theatrical performances

NOTE:
ドラマ is often used to describe dramatic, exciting real-life events as well.
